cc:Work.dc:title: danza-de-la-muerte-09
cc:Work.dc:description:
Illustrations from 'Heidelberger Totentanz' — book, printed in 1488 and portrayed 'Le Danse Macabre' at first time. Link to book: http://digi.ub.uni-heidelberg.de/diglit/totentanz1488. 
 
You can find two of clipart's in 'cliparteles' user submissions: 
1. http://www.openclipart.org/detail/141451/la-danza-de-la-muerte-by-cliparteles 
2. http://www.openclipart.org/detail/141475/la-danza-de-la-muerte-2-by-cliparteles 
 
I've plan to upload all of illustrations.
